NOTES - GENERIC DYNAMIC REFERENCE PATTERNS
-------------------------------------------
The following generic dynamic patterns exist. They use variables that
are resolved at render time, so any asset could theoretically be loaded.
No specific asset was upgraded to DYNAMIC based on these alone; each
unreferenced asset was still reported individually above.

snippets/lazy-load-asset-group.liquid
    lazy_script | asset_url | json

snippets/lazy-load-asset-group.liquid
    lazy_style | asset_url | json

assets/search.min.js
    miniCssF: chunkId + ".min.css" (numeric chunk id based CSS loading)
